4. Extend right elbow down in control to start, then alternate to left arm.

3. Squat down with control using both legs until the back leg's knee is 3-5 cm off the ground; then return to the starting position with control using both legs.
breathTip:
Exhale on standing up
Inhale on the squat

name: Weighted Split Squat (R)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees aligned with toes; position the right leg forward with a front-to-back distance of 1-1.2 meters, engage the core, and maintain a neutral spine.  
2. Grip the handles with each hand, pressing arms against the torso.  
3. Squat down with control using both legs until the back leg's knee is 3-5 cm off the ground; then return to the starting position with control using both legs.
breathTip:
Exhale on standing up
Inhale on the squat

name: Cable Arm Swing
trainingPoint:
1. Grip the handle with both hands.  
2. Depress the shoulders, maintain a neutral spine, keep the core stable, and bend the knees slightly.  
3. Exert force with both arms to quickly swing them out forcefully toward the back of the body.  
4. Return to the starting position with control.
breathTip:
Exhale on exertion
Inhale on the return

name: Lying Leg Curl
trainingPoint:
1. Fasten the ankle strap securely, lie down on the training bench, and hold the bench with both hands to stabilize your body. 
2. Extend your legs straight, tighten your core, engage your hamstring muscles, and flex your toes to bend your calves upward. 
3. Return to the starting position.
breathTip:
Exhale forcefully
Inhale on the return

name: Standing Knee Raise (L)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand in a standing position, with one hand gripping the side of the equipment and the other hand resting on the hip.  
2. Throughout the movement, keep the back erect, maintain body stability, and engage the core.  
3. Lift the thigh until it is parallel to the ground.
breathTip:
Exhale on exertion
Inhale on the return

name: Standing Knee Raise (R)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand in a standing position, with one hand gripping the side of the equipment and the other hand resting on the hip.  
2. Throughout the movement, keep the back erect, maintain body stability, and engage the core.  
3. Lift the thigh until it is parallel to the ground.
breathTip:
Exhale on exertion
Inhale on the return

name: Lying Scissor Kicks
trainingPoint:
1. Lie supine on the training bench with your head lifted off the bench, slightly tuck your chin, and secure the straps around both feet.  
2. Engage the core, exert force with the abdomen, and perform cross-legged leg raises with both feet.  
3. Grip the training bench with both hands to ensure movement stability.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Kneeling Glute Kickback (L)
trainingPoint:
1. Kneel on one leg on a flat bench, keeping your back straight.
2. Secure the ankle strap and hold the edge of the bench to stabilize your body
3. Lift your left leg straight up to the highest point and hold briefly.
4. Lower your leg slowly back to the starting position.
breathTip:
Exhale on exertion
Inhale on the return

name: Kneeling Glute Kickback (R)
trainingPoint:
1. Kneel on one leg on a flat bench, keeping your back straight.
2. Secure the ankle strap and hold the edge of the bench to stabilize your body.
3. Lift your right leg straight up to the highest point and hold briefly.
4. Lower your leg slowly back to the starting position.
breathTip:
Exhale on exertion
Inhale on the return

name: Seated Alternating Leg Extension
trainingPoint:
1. Support your body with hands behind you, knees bent at 90 degrees in preparation.
2. Use one thigh to pull the rope until your knee is fully extended.
3. Slowly return to the starting position and switch to the other thigh.
breathTip:
Exhale on knee extension
Inhale on the return

name: Kneeling Rope Crunch
trainingPoint:
1. Kneel on both knees, keep your upper body upright, engage your core, and hold both ends of the double-handled rope above your head.
2. Relax your hands, engage your abs, pull the rope down until your elbows touch the ground, then controlled return to the starting position.
breathTip:
Exhale on the way down
Inhale on the way up

name: Kneeling Push-up
trainingPoint:
1. Hands shoulder-width apart, forming a straight line from shoulders to elbows to wrists, engage your core and glutes, knees on the ground with legs crossed.
2. Lower your body in a controlled manner until your chest is about one fist away from the ground, with elbows at approximately 45 degrees to your torso.
3. Push your body back up to the starting position.
breathTip:
Exhale on the way up
Inhale on the way down

name: Push-up
trainingPoint:
1. Hands shoulder-width apart, forming a straight line from shoulders to elbows to wrists perpendicular to the ground, engage your core and glutes, legs together.
2. Keep your head neutral, chin slightly tucked, eyes looking straight down.
3. Lower your body in a controlled manner until your chest is about one fist away from the ground, with elbows at approximately 45 degrees to your torso.
4. Push your body back up to the starting position.
breathTip:
Exhale on the way up
Inhale on the way down

name: Plank
trainingPoint:
1. Elbows on ground shoulder-width apart, shoulders, elbows and wrists in a straight line perpendicular to ground. Legs together, straight and tight, toes on ground.
2. Engage core, squeeze glutes, keep entire body in a horizontal line.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Hamstring Stretch
trainingPoint:
1. Feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Step one leg forward, keep back leg slightly bent.
3. Lean upper body forward, extend arms straight, slide hands past front foot. Return to upright when bringing leg back, alternate sides.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Good Morning
trainingPoint:
1. Hands on sides of head, elbows open to sides, keep back straight, knees slightly bent for stability.
2. Bend forward at waist, push hips back, lean until torso is nearly parallel to ground.
breathTip:
Inhale on forward fold
Exhale on standing up

name: Squat with Hip Rotation
trainingPoint:
1. Feet apart, squat naturally, knees slightly open.
2. Perform left hip adduction, alternate sides.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Cross-Body Toe Touch
trainingPoint:
1. Sit on yoga mat, elbows slightly bent supporting behind body, knees slightly bent, heels on ground.
2. Engage abs, lift left leg, touch left toe with right hand, alternate sides.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Ankle Circles
trainingPoint:
1. Feet shoulder-width apart, heels on ground, lift toes up.
2. Place toes on ground, lift heels up, alternate between two movements.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Thoracic Rotation
trainingPoint:
1. Feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent.
2. Hands on knees, rotate torso to one side, extend same-side arm upward to maximum range, alternate sides.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Jumping Jacks (Chest)
trainingPoint:
1. Feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent.
2. Bend elbows, flex shoulders to 90 degrees, arms parallel to ground.
3. Step side to side, clap hands in front of chest simultaneously.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Lunge with Arm Raise
trainingPoint:
1. Feet slightly wider than shoulders, hands up to ears, arms parallel.
2. Step one leg diagonally back, swing hands down beyond body plane, lean upper body slightly forward, alternate sides.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Lat Stretch
trainingPoint:
1. Feet slightly wider than shoulders.
2. Clasp hands above head, elbows slightly bent, lean upper body left, feel stretch on right waist and lats, alternate sides.
breathTip:
Exhale on the way down
Inhale on the return

name: Upper Back Stretch
trainingPoint:
1. Feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Extend hands back to maximum range, keep parallel to ground, feel chest stretch.
3. Clasp hands in front, arch upper back backward.
breathTip:
Exhale on arching back
Inhale on the return

name: Standing Crunch
trainingPoint:
1. Feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Stand on one leg, lift the other with knee bent 90 degrees.
3. Touch lifted knee with opposite elbow, alternate sides.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Glute Kickback with Chest Opener
trainingPoint:
1. Feet slightly wider than shoulders.
2. Bend elbows to 90 degrees, lift to shoulder height.
3. Stand on one leg, kick the other back until heel touches glutes, perform chest fly with hands simultaneously.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Hip Rotation
trainingPoint:
1. Stand naturally, hands on hips.
2. Lift one leg to side, return to standing, pause briefly then repeat with other leg.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Bent-Knee Calf Raise
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with knees slightly bent.
2. Rise onto tiptoes, hold for 2 seconds, return to starting position.
breathTip:
Exhale on tiptoe
Inhale on release

name: Alternating Glute Bridge
trainingPoint:
1. Lie on back with knees bent, hold right ankle pulling towards chest.
2. Lift hips with left leg support until knee, hip and shoulder form a straight line.
3. Alternate sides.
breathTip:
Exhale on raise
Inhale on lower

name: Shoulder Stretch
trainingPoint:
1. Stand, clasp hands, straighten elbows, flex shoulders to 180 degrees.
2. Stretch hands forward as far as possible, lift slowly to maximum range, rise onto tiptoes simultaneously, hold for 2 seconds.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Foam Roller Upper Back
trainingPoint:
1. Lie on back, place foam roller horizontally under upper back.
2. Clasp hands supporting head.
3. Roll slowly in small range from shoulder blades to lower upper back, do not roll lower back.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Frog Glute Bridge
trainingPoint:
1. Lie on back, hands by sides, heels together, knees bent at 90 degrees.
2. Engage core, keep torso and hips on ground.
3. Lift hips with controlled movement until hips, knees and shoulders form a straight line.
4. Lower hips slowly back to ground.
breathTip:
Exhale on the way up
Inhale on the way down

name: Side Bend Stretch
trainingPoint:
1. Stand, feet shoulder-width apart.
2. Clasp hands, raise above head, keep shoulders and back straight.
3. Rotate slowly to one side, hold for 15 seconds when slight stretch is felt, alternate sides.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: W-Raise
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart,knees aligned with toes, slight knee bend, torso slightly forward-leaning.
2. Thumbs up, lower arms to parallel with the ground forming a 'W' shape with torso, squeeze shoulder blades for 1 second.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: T-Raise
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart,knees aligned with toes, slight knee bend, torso slightly forward. 
2. Thumbs up, raise arms to shoulder height, forming a 'T' shape with torso, squeeze shoulder blades for 1 second.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Y-Raise
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart,knees aligned with toes, slight knee bend, torso slightly forward. 
2. Thumbs up, extend arms outward, forming a 'Y' shape with torso, squeeze shoulder blades for 1 second.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Knee Tuck
trainingPoint:
1. Sit back on floor, hips grounded, hands supporting behind, knees slightly bent, engage abs to stabilize. 
2. Pull knees in while contracting abs, slight torso flexion, then return to start.
breathTip:
Inhale on leg extension
Exhale on leg flexion

name: Front Kicks
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet slightly apart, hands overhead. 
2. Keep torso stable, alternate lifting legs to maximum range, lower arms to touch front of lower leg while lifting. 
3. Slight knee bend.
breathTip:
Exhale when lifting your leg
Inhale on the way down

name: Upper Back Stretch (Cat)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand naturally, interlock fingers, palms facing body, then flip hands to push forward with backs of hands. 
2. Lower head, arch back backward to maximum range following hand movement.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Lunge with Twist
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet together naturally. 
2. Step forward into lunge, front lower leg vertical, thigh parallel to floor, back foot toes forward aligned with knee. 
3. Extend arms to cross in front, then reach upward to maximum, follow hands with eyes, lower arms to chest, return to start and switch legs.
breathTip:
Inhale on the stretch
Exhale on the return

name: Dynamic Abs
trainingPoint:
1. Lie flat on yoga mat, feet together, bend knees and lift legs while slightly raising hips, press lower back firmly to floor. 
2. Engage core, slightly lift shoulders off floor, vibrate hands up and down to stimulate ab contraction.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Chest Squeeze
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet naturally apart, upper arms parallel to floor, forearms perpendicular to upper arms. 
2. Adduct upper arms, touch forearms together, then return to start.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Angel Wings
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet naturally apart, upper arms parallel to floor, forearms perpendicular to upper arms. 
2. Adduct upper arms, keep forearms touching throughout, slowly move up and down.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Squat with Arm Raise
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart,knees aligned with toes, slightly bent knees, torso slightly leaning forward.
2. Thumbs up, raise arms to parallel with the ground, forming a 'T' shape with torso, squeeze shoulder blades for 1 second.
breathTip:
Inhale on the arm raise
Exhale on the return

name: Lying Thoracic Rotation (L)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart,knees aligned with toes, slightly bent knees, torso slightly leaning forward.
2. Thumbs up, extend arms outward, forming a 'Y' shape with torso, squeeze shoulder blades for 1 second.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Lying Thoracic Rotation (R)
trainingPoint:
1. Sit back on the floor, hips touching the ground, hands supporting behind, slightly bent knees, engage abdominal muscles to stabilize body.
2. Retract legs while contracting abdomen, slightly bend body, then return to starting position.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Chest Opener
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet slightly apart, hands raised above head.
2. Keep upper body stable, alternately lift feet to maximum range, while lowering arms to touch front of lower legs.
3. Slightly bend knees.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Shoulder Circles
trainingPoint:
1. Stand naturally, interlock fingers, palms facing body, then turn palms outward and push hands forward.
2. Lower head, arch back to maximum range following hand movement.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Plank Jacks
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet together.
2. Step forward into a lunge, front lower leg perpendicular to ground, thigh parallel to ground, back foot toes forward aligned with knee.
3. Extend arms to meet in front, then stretch upward to maximum range, follow hands with eyes, lower arms to chest, switch legs and repeat.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Toe Touch with Rotation
trainingPoint:
1. Lie flat on yoga mat, feet together, bend knees and lift legs while slightly raising hips, press lower back firmly to ground.
2. Engage core, slightly lift shoulders off ground, vibrate hands up and down to stimulate abdominal contraction.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Inchworm
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet naturally apart, upper arms parallel to ground, forearms perpendicular to upper arms.
2. Adduct upper arms, touch forearms together, then return to starting position.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Butt Kicks
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet naturally apart, upper arms parallel to ground, forearms perpendicular to upper arms.
2. Adduct upper arms, keep forearms touching, slowly move up and down continuously.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Lateral Lunge
trainingPoint:
1. Squat fully, relax legs.
2. Lift one arm and stretch upward forcefully, follow with eyes until fully extended, hold briefly then return.
3. Use the other arm to press inside of knee to prevent leg rotation, alternate arms.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Quad Stretch
trainingPoint:
1. Lie on side, bend knees to 90 degrees, thighs at 90 degrees to torso, extend arms forward.
2. Keep thighs and torso stable, open top arm to opposite direction to maximum range.
3. Keep thighs and torso stable, controlled return of top arm to starting position.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Seated Hamstring Stretch (R)
trainingPoint:
1. Lie on side, bend knees to 90 degrees, thighs at 90 degrees to torso, extend arms forward.
2. Keep thighs and torso stable, open top arm to opposite direction to maximum range.
3. Keep thighs and torso stable, controlled return of top arm to starting position.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Seated Hamstring Stretch (L)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with legs straight, engage abdomen and chest, keep head upright.
2. Bend arms backward then open to sides, feel chest stretch.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Oblique Stretch (L)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, extend arms to sides, thumbs up.
2. Circle both arms upward simultaneously to activate shoulder joints.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Oblique Stretch (R)
trainingPoint:
1. Lie prone on yoga mat, elbows supporting body.
2. Jump feet in and out, slightly lower hips when jumping, keep knees straight.
3. Keep legs and upper body as tight as possible.
4. Minimize hip movement range.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Glute Stretch (L)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet about 1 meter apart, toes forward, bend forward with straight legs.
2. Keep one hand touching opposite foot, stretch the other hand to same direction to maximum range, hold for 2 seconds, alternate sides.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Glute Stretch (R)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with straight legs, full feet on ground, crawl hands forward as far as possible, keep arms straight.
2. Keep feet in place, after straightening back and arms, crawl hands back to starting position.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Cat-Cow
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart,knees aligned with toes.
2. Alternately lift knees forcefully until heels nearly touch buttocks.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Cross-Body Arm Swing
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet about 1.2 meters apart,toes forward, knees aligned with toes.
2. Keep left leg stable, squat right leg in a controlled manner to lowest position, maintain toe direction during movement.
3. Controlled return of right leg to starting position, alternate sides.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Upward-Facing Dog
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees aligned with toes.
2. Stand on one leg, bend the other leg, use same-side hand to hold ankle and pull heel toward buttocks, alternate legs.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Child's Pose
trainingPoint:
1. Sit on yoga mat, cross one leg, extend the other leg forward.
2. Raise arms, lean torso forward until hands grasp heel, feel stretch on back of thigh.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Figure-4 Glute Stretch (R)
trainingPoint:
1. Sit on yoga mat, cross one leg, extend the other leg forward.
2. Raise arms, lean torso forward until hands grasp heel, feel stretch on back of thigh.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Figure-4 Glute Stretch (L)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with wide stance, bend body to the right.
2. Simultaneously raise left hand, touch right toe with right hand, look upward.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with wide stance, bend body to the left.
2. Simultaneously raise right hand, touch left toe with left hand, look upward.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Standing Forward Fold
trainingPoint:
1. Sit on yoga mat, bend left knee, extend right leg backward, raise hands.
2. Keep body and pelvis facing forward, lean torso downward until hands touch ground, feel stretch on right hip.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Clamshell (L)
trainingPoint:
1. Sit on yoga mat, bend right knee, extend left leg backward, raise hands.
2. Keep body and pelvis facing forward, lean torso downward until hands touch ground, feel stretch on left hip.
breathTip:
Inhale downward
Exhale backwards

name: Clamshell (R)
trainingPoint:
1. Quadruped position (hands and knees), hands and legs shoulder-width apart perpendicular to ground, knees and hips at 90 degrees, engage core, neutral spine.
2. Exhale, contract abdomen, slowly arch back upward, turn face downward to look at thighs, feel back stretch.
3. Inhale, slowly lift pelvis, press lower back downward, form a downward curve like a cat, slowly lift head, look diagonally upward, do not overraise head.
breathTip:
Inhale downward
Exhale backwards

name: Hip Flexor Stretch (L)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees aligned with toes.
2. Slowly raise right arm to side of head, simultaneously lower left arm to side, alternate hands.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Hip Flexor Stretch (R)
trainingPoint:
1. Lie prone on ground, abdomen touching ground, extend legs and relax.
2. Push upper body up with hands forcefully, slightly raise chin, expand chest, lean body backward, feel abdominal stretch, hold for 30 seconds.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Single-leg squat (L)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees aligned with toes, hands clasped in front of chest.
2. Shift weight to right leg, lift left knee, place left ankle on right thigh.
3. Slowly squat down on supporting leg, go as low as possible.
breathTip:
Exhale on squat
Inhale on the return

name: Single-leg squat(R)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees aligned with toes, hands clasped in front of chest.
2. Stand on left leg, lift right knee to hip level, place right ankle on left thigh, then slowly squat down as far as possible.
breathTip:
Exhale on squat
Inhale on the return

name: Calf Stretch
trainingPoint: 1. Stand with toes of the leg to be stretched lifted, feeling the stretch in the gastrocnemius muscle.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Piriformis Stretch (L)
trainingPoint:
1. Bend left leg, extend right leg, assume push-up position on yoga mat.
2. Keep right leg straight, engage core, feeling the stretch in the piriformis muscle.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Piriformis Stretch (R)
trainingPoint:
1. Bend right leg, extend left leg, assume push-up position on yoga mat.
2. Keep left leg straight, engage core, feeling the stretch in the piriformis muscle.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Foam Rolling Calves
trainingPoint:
1. Sit on the floor, place foam roller under calf muscles.
2. Support body with hands behind you, roll foam roller back and forth to release tension in calves.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Foam Rolling Thighs
trainingPoint:
1. Sit on the floor, place foam roller under hamstrings.
2. Support body with hands behind you, roll foam roller back and forth to release tension in hamstrings.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Adductor Stretch
trainingPoint:
1. Spread knees as wide as comfortable, keep inner thighs and calves touching the floor.
2. Place arms on floor, relax entire body.
3. Adjust hip position slightly to find optimal stretch.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Anterior Chain Stretch
trainingPoint:
1. Kneel on yoga mat, feet together, hands behind body, push hips forward, keep back straight.
2. Feel the stretch in the front of the body.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Upper Trap Stretch (L)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand upright, tilt head to the right, place right hand on head, gently pull head sideways.
2. Feel the stretch in the neck and shoulders.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Upper Trap Stretch (R)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand upright, tilt head to the left, place left hand on head, gently pull head sideways.
2. Feel the stretch in the neck and shoulders.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Tricep Stretch (L)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand straight, lift left arm overhead, bend it as much as possible, grasp left elbow with right hand.
2. Gently pull left elbow behind head, feel stretch at back of upper arm.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Tricep Stretch (R)
trainingPoint:
1. Stand straight, lift right arm overhead, bend it as much as possible, grasp right elbow with left hand.
2. Gently pull right elbow behind head, feel stretch at back of upper arm.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Bicep Stretch (L)
trainingPoint:
1. Hold rack with left hand, rotate inward, step forward with opposite leg.
2. Slowly bend legs, keep upper body upright, feel stretch in arm.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Bicep Stretch (R)
trainingPoint:
1. Hold rack with right hand, rotate inward, step forward with opposite leg.
2. Slowly bend legs, keep upper body upright, feel stretch in arm.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: World's Greatest Stretch
trainingPoint:
1. Take a big step forward, foot lands outside same-side arm.
2. Bend arm, lower elbow to near ground, then turn and straighten arm upward, look at raised arm.
3. Return to start, alternate sides.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Lying Chest Stretch (L)
trainingPoint:
1. Lie on stomach, left arm straight forward on mat, right hand supports body.
2. Bend right leg back, use right hand to rotate body left, look upward.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Lying Chest Stretch (R)
trainingPoint:
1. Lie on stomach, right arm straight forward on mat, left hand supports body.
2. Bend left leg back, use left hand to rotate body left, look upward.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Squat to Knee Raise
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder, bend elbows, hands at chest.
2. Squat until thighs parallel to ground, knees align with toes.
3. Alternate knee lifts.
breathTip:
Inhale on the squat
Exhale on standing up

name: Flutter Kicks
trainingPoint:
1. Lie on back on yoga mat, hands at sides.
2. Straighten legs up, alternate lifting and lowering, keep lower back pressed to mat.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Jog in Place
trainingPoint:
1. Keep back straight, look forward.
2. Maintain stability, alternate leg lifts in place with rhythm, like jogging.
3. Keep moderate pace - you should be able to speak normally while jogging.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Jumping Jacks
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width, arms straight at sides, core engaged, neutral spine.
2. Jump feet apart, raise arms overhead and clap hands.
3. Jump feet together, lower arms back to sides.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Mountain Climbers
trainingPoint:
1. Start on all fours, hands and knees shoulder-width apart, brace core, keep neutral spine.
2. Drive one knee straight forward toward your chest, then quickly return to the starting position. Alternate legs.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: High Knees
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees tracking over toes.
2. Alternately lift legs until thighs are parallel to the floor, knees bent at 90°.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Burpees
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, tracking over toes.
2. Hinge into a squat, place hands shoulder-width apart on the floor, jump feet back fully extended. Quickly pull knees toward your chest, jump up, and clap hands overhead.
breathTip: Natural breathing

name: Squat Thrusts
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, toes turned out slightly. Squat down until thighs are parallel to the ground, raising arms straight overhead so that arms and torso are in the same plane, palms forward, back straight.
2. Jump up explosively, bringing feet together and pulling hands back to the sides of head.
Jump up again while spreading legs apart. 
3. Land with bent knees to absorb impact, lower into a squat, extend arms overhead and return to starting position.
breathTip:
Exhale when jumping up
Inhale on the squat

name: Curtsy Lunge
trainingPoint:
1. Clasp hands together, keep back straight, engage glutes.
2. Perform a squat first, extend right leg to the left rear, squat again, return to start, alternate legs.
3. As you squat diagonally, extend your back leg as far sideways as possible.
4. Keep knees from extending past your toes with every squat.
breathTip:
Inhale on the squat
Exhale on standing up

name: Squat Jumps
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
2. Place hands at chest level, brace core, keep neutral spine as you squat down.
3. Lower slowly and controlled until mid-thighs are parallel to the floor, knees tracking over toes throughout.
4. Drive through glutes and legs, push through feet to jump off the ground.
5. Land on the balls of your feet, bend knees slightly to absorb impact, then repeat.
breathTip:
Exhale when jumping up
Inhale on the squat

name: Bodyweight Squat
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
2. Extend arms forward parallel to the floor, brace core, keep neutral spine.
3. Keep arms stationary, lower slowly and controlled until mid-thighs are parallel to the floor, knees tracking over toes throughout.
4. Push back up to starting position with control.
breathTip:
Inhale on the squat
Exhale on standing up

name: Wide-Stance Toe Squat
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with feet 1.5x shoulder-width apart, toes flared out, then lower into a squat.
2. Rise onto the balls of your feet as you squat down, until thighs are parallel to the floor.
3. Lower heels to the floor as you push up to stand, returning to the starting position.
breathTip:
Inhale on tiptoe
Exhale on the squat

name: Box Squat
trainingPoint:
1. Stand with your legs apart, shoulder-width apart, and position yourself at the edge of the training bench.
2. Tighten your core, keep your back straight, and squat down until your hips sit on the training bench.
3. Slowly stand up until you return to your original position.
breathTip:
Inhale on the way down
Exhale on the way up
